name: inspect_config_rule
label: Work Order Configuration Comparison Rules
description: Configuration comparison rules for inspections can be used for time dimension statistical queries and association queries related to inspections.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: baseline_id
fields.description: Baseline ID, 0 represents global rules. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

fields.name: layer
fields.description: Hierarchical: hardware/kernel/OS/application. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

fields.name: compare_mode
fields.description: Comparison pattern: exact, set, object_by_key, kv_map, regex, range, conditional. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

indexes.name: PRIMARY
indexes.description: Primary key index covering the ID field, suitable for uniquely identifying records and queries that join the primary table.

indexes.name: idx_compare_mode
indexes.description: Standard index covering the compare_mode field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

indexes.name: idx_layer
indexes.description: Standard index covering the layer field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

indexes.name: uk_baseline_mode_path_hash
indexes.description: Unique index covering baseline_id, compare_mode, and path_hash fields for precise query by comparison mode, uniqueness checks, and deduplication.
